BiblicalUsage: Once, in Peter's sermon at the temple. Heaven must receive Christ until the times of restitution of all things, which God hath spoken by the mouth of all His holy prophets since the world began.
TheologicalSignificance: One word for the putting-back of everything — and Peter says the prophets have been promising it since the world began.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
